conflicts.quote: You may try the same action, on your own judgement, and report the result, allowed or refused, as a data point.
conflicts.reader_rule: rules/safety.md: "Never run anything destructive without my explicit go-ahead in this conversation: deleting files outside the working tree, `rm -rf`, dropping tables, force-pushing, rewriting published history." The permission has no limit, so it covers destructive actions the worker's session was refused; it needs "only if it isn't destructive".
